resolution.note: #1523: Claude Code rewrite and Codex refusal hooks installed host-wide from the release, ~/.local/bin/heavy-gate linked, host patterns for replay/judge scripts in ~/.config/krn/heavy-gate.json. Proof: two scratch projects' npm test through the rewritten command at once: one held the slot, the other waited and got it after 25.5s. Load stayed ~28 (above 20) from work outside the gate (systemd scans t-xwp1ft2, agent-browser Chrome, unmatched scripts), so the load criterion is not met yet. title: Other projects' heavy commands run through the host heavy-job gate
body:
Source: t-c0k4wdz shipped the host heavy-job gate (scripts/host/heavy-gate.ts, src/repo/host-gate.ts) with KRN fast and the Stop hook as its only clients. Operator grant: memory host-capacity-grant ("wszystkie projekty").
Outcome: the heavy commands of the other projects on this laptop (their test runners, builds, package installs; the measured offenders were re-imagine design-bench judge runs, elektroinstal QA captures, mise-en-plesk, playwright) reach the gate without editing their code: a host entry `heavy-gate run -- <cmd>` on PATH from the released checkout, and each project's KRN wiring (its test/fast contract command or agent hook) wraps its heavy commands with it. A project whose wiring cannot be changed is named with the reason. wilq-seo is never gated.
Proof: with two projects running their test command at once, `node scripts/host/heavy-gate.ts status` lists both as holders or one waiting; the sampler (t-cpe5qv7) shows load below cores x 1.25 during their runs.
